first_factory_act.name: First Factory Act
first_factory_act.observation: The new law is nailed to the mill gate: bound parish children may work no more than twelve hours, and must be taught their letters on the Sabbath.
first_factory_act.ability_reason: For the first time the realm reaches past the master's door and says a child's working day has an end, however long.
first_factory_act.social_consequence: Parish apprentices gain a little sleep; mill masters grumble at a rule that, with no one sent to enforce it, they mostly ignore.

overlookers_foremen.name: Overlookers and Foremen
overlookers_foremen.observation: The overlooker walks the aisles between the frames with a strap in his belt, fining any piecer caught idle or late back from the privy.

weavers_minimum_rate_petition.name: Weavers' Rate Petition
weavers_minimum_rate_petition.observation: Thirty thousand hand weavers set their marks to a petition for a legal minimum rate; the council reads it, thanks them, and refuses.

secret_trade_societies.name: Secret Trade Societies
secret_trade_societies.observation: The knitters meet by candle in an upstairs tavern room, swear an oath on the holy book with the door barred, and pass the box for the tramping men.

handloom_weaver_distress.name: Hand-Loom Weavers' Distress
handloom_weaver_distress.observation: A weaver who once earned a gold coin a week now sits sixteen hours at his loom for a quarter of it, his children winding bobbins beside him.
handloom_weaver_distress.social_consequence: Cloth grows cheap for every household; the old weaving villages starve slowly while the power-loom sheds fill with their daughters.

spinners_federation.name: Spinners' Federation
spinners_federation.observation: Delegates from a dozen mill towns crowd a public-house room and agree one fund, one list of prices, and one strike if any town is cut.

union_tramping_cards.name: Union Tramping Cards
union_tramping_cards.observation: A journeyman out of work walks into a strange town, shows his society card at the club-house inn, and is given a bed, a meal and word of a job.

mechanics_institutes.name: Mechanics' Institutes
mechanics_institutes.observation: After the day shift, forty men in their work coats sit on benches while a lecturer demonstrates the lever and the steam gauge by lamplight.

combination_ban_repeal.name: Combination Ban Repealed
combination_ban_repeal.observation: The clause making it a crime for workmen to combine is struck from the statute book, and trade clubs hang their banners openly over tavern doors.
combination_ban_repeal.ability_reason: Once workers may lawfully bargain together, disputes move from night-time frame breaking into open negotiation.
combination_ban_repeal.social_consequence: Journeymen gain a lawful voice; masters lose the magistrate as their enforcer and face a wave of strikes in the first year.

master_servant_penalties.name: Master and Servant Penalties
master_servant_penalties.observation: A collier who walked off before his yearly bond expired stands in the dock; the magistrate gives him three months' hard labor.

mine_butty_gangs.name: Butty Gang System
mine_butty_gangs.observation: The butty takes the stall at a price per ton from the owner, hires his own gang, and pays them on a Saturday night at his own beerhouse.

coin_wages_act.name: Coin Wages Act
coin_wages_act.observation: Paymasters now count out coin at the pay window; the tokens that were good only at the company shop are swept into a bucket and melted.

factory_inspectorate.name: Factory Inspectorate
factory_inspectorate.observation: A gentleman in a travelling coat arrives unannounced, asks for the register of ages, and sends the nine-year-olds home from the carding room.
factory_inspectorate.ability_reason: Law on hours means nothing until someone is paid to walk into the mills and check; inspectors turn statute into practice.

chattel_bondage_abolition.name: Bondage Abolished
chattel_bondage_abolition.observation: At midnight the bells ring on the plantation islands; by dawn the field gangs are free, though bound for years more as unpaid apprentices.
chattel_bondage_abolition.ability_reason: Ending ownership of people removes the realm's deepest injustice and forces planters to hire labor at a wage.
chattel_bondage_abolition.social_consequence: The freed gain their own bodies and families; owners are paid a vast compensation from the treasury while the freed receive nothing.

indentured_contract_migration.name: Indentured Contract Migration
indentured_contract_migration.observation: Hundreds of contract laborers, each marked with a number on a tin ticket, climb from the depot to a ship bound for cane fields half the world away.
indentured_contract_migration.social_consequence: Planters replace freed field hands cheaply; the indentured endure crowded voyages, penal contracts and fevers far from home.

underground_work_limits.name: Underground Work Limits
underground_work_limits.observation: The trapper girls who sat alone in the dark opening air doors are brought up the shaft for good; boys under ten no longer go below.

consumer_cooperatives.name: Cooperative Stores
consumer_cooperatives.observation: Weavers pool a pound each to open a shop selling honest flour and tea; at the quarter they share the surplus by what each member bought.

half_time_schooling.name: Half-Time Schooling
half_time_schooling.observation: Mill children work the morning shift, eat their bread, and file into the schoolroom at one, many nodding asleep over their slates.

ten_hour_day.name: Ten-Hour Day
ten_hour_day.observation: The engine is stopped at six in the evening; women and youths stream out in daylight, and the men's day is shortened with theirs.
ten_hour_day.ability_reason: The day that ran twelve and fourteen hours is cut by law, and masters find output falls far less than they feared.
ten_hour_day.social_consequence: Families gain evenings; mill owners pay more per yard and some move to longer shifts for men alone.

amalgamated_craft_unions.name: Amalgamated Craft Unions
amalgamated_craft_unions.observation: The society's head office keeps ledgers of sick pay, tool insurance and funeral benefit for fifty thousand engineers, run by a paid secretary.
amalgamated_craft_unions.ability_reason: A national union with officers and funds can outlast a strike and bargain steadily, not just flare up and fold.
amalgamated_craft_unions.social_consequence: Skilled men win security and respect; the unskilled laborers beside them are shut out of the society and its wages.

saturday_half_holiday.name: Saturday Half-Holiday
saturday_half_holiday.observation: At two on Saturday the workshops close; by three the playing fields and the excursion trains are crowded with clerks and mill hands.

district_rate_lists.name: District Rate Lists
district_rate_lists.observation: A printed list pinned in every weaving shed of the district sets the same price for a piece of each width and pick, down to the farthing.

sweated_home_work.name: Sweated Home Work
sweated_home_work.observation: In a single garret a widow and three daughters stitch trousers at a sewing machine by candlelight for the middleman's pittance per dozen.
sweated_home_work.social_consequence: Ready-made clothes grow cheap in every shop; the women who sew them work eighteen hours in rooms where fevers spread through the cloth.

company_towns.name: Company Towns
company_towns.observation: Every house in the row, the chapel, the store and the reading room belong to the works; a man who strikes loses his roof the same week.

railway_staff_hierarchy.name: Railway Staff Hierarchy
railway_staff_hierarchy.observation: Porters, guards, signalmen and stationmasters wear numbered caps and brass buttons, and each carries a rule book he must know by heart.

worker_owned_workshops.name: Worker-Owned Workshops
worker_owned_workshops.observation: The cabinetmakers elect their own manager and share the year's profit; their workshop door carries a painted sign reading "Our Own".

employer_lockouts.name: Employer Lockouts
employer_lockouts.observation: The gates of every engineering shop in the district are chained on the same Monday; the men are told to return when they drop the union.

union_legal_standing.name: Unions Given Legal Standing
union_legal_standing.observation: A union treasurer who absconded with the funds is now prosecuted like any other thief, and the courts no longer treat a strike as conspiracy.
union_legal_standing.ability_reason: With funds protected and strikes no longer criminal conspiracy, unions become permanent institutions employers must deal with.

machine_guarding_rules.name: Machine Guarding Rules
machine_guarding_rules.observation: Wooden casings now box in every shaft and gear wheel under seven feet, and the inspector notes each unfenced belt in his book.

conciliation_boards.name: Conciliation Boards
conciliation_boards.observation: Six masters and six workmen sit across a long table with a neutral chairman, arguing over the price of a gross of nails until they agree.

peaceful_picketing.name: Peaceful Picketing
peaceful_picketing.observation: Four strikers in their Sunday coats stand at the works gate with a placard, handing leaflets to anyone who would take their jobs.

trade_wide_employer_bargaining.name: Trade-Wide Bargaining
trade_wide_employer_bargaining.observation: The ironmasters' association and the union executive sign one agreement binding every foundry in the trade for a year.

rail_harvest_gangs.name: Rail Harvest Gangs
rail_harvest_gangs.observation: Special trains carry gangs of reapers south to north as the grain ripens, each gang sleeping in barns and moving on when the field is cut.

labor_statistics_bureau.name: Labor Statistics Bureau
labor_statistics_bureau.observation: Clerks tabulate returns from every county: weekly wages, hours, strikes begun and settled, and the price of bread against them.

employer_liability_law.name: Employer Liability Law
employer_liability_law.observation: A brakeman who lost his arm to a faulty coupling sues the railway and wins, though the lawyers take a third of the award.

women_office_clerks.name: Women Office Clerks
women_office_clerks.observation: Rows of young women in white blouses sit at typewriting machines in the insurance office, where only men in frock coats wrote before.

shop_hours_limits.name: Shop Hours Limits
shop_hours_limits.observation: Shop assistants who stood behind counters until midnight now pull the shutters at eight, and one weekday afternoon the high street is closed.

blacklists_and_no_union_pledges.name: Blacklists and Pledges
blacklists_and_no_union_pledges.observation: Before he is taken on, each man must sign a paper swearing he belongs to no union; the organiser's name circulates to every mill office in the valley.

profit_sharing_schemes.name: Profit-Sharing Schemes
profit_sharing_schemes.observation: At the year's end each gasworker receives a bonus certificate in the company, payable only if he has stayed loyal and struck no work.

accident_insurance.name: Accident Insurance
accident_insurance.observation: A millwright crushed under a falling beam draws a weekly allowance from the trade insurance fund within a month, without ever seeing a lawyer.
accident_insurance.ability_reason: Pooling the cost of injury across a whole trade replaces ruinous lawsuits with certain relief and pushes employers to make work safer.
accident_insurance.social_consequence: Injured workers gain a steady allowance; employers pay levies graded by the danger of their trade.

time_clock_recording.name: Time Clock Recording
time_clock_recording.observation: Each worker drops his brass check into the clock at the gate, and the machine stamps the minute of his arrival on a paper card.

eight_hour_campaign.name: Eight-Hour Campaign
eight_hour_campaign.observation: On the first of the spring month a hundred thousand workers march behind banners reading eight hours for work, eight for sleep, eight for what we will.

general_unions.name: General Unions
general_unions.observation: Casual dockers who fought each other at the call-on gate for a half-day's work now carry one union card and strike as one port.

job_cost_accounting.name: Job Cost Accounting
job_cost_accounting.observation: A clerk tallies every hour of labor and every pound of iron against the job ticket, so the works knows the true cost of each engine.

child_labor_prohibition.name: Child Labor Forbidden
child_labor_prohibition.observation: The bobbin boys and half-timers are gone from the mill; at nine each morning they sit in the board school until their fourteenth birthday.
child_labor_prohibition.ability_reason: Keeping every child in school until fourteen trades cheap labor now for a literate, healthier workforce a generation later.
child_labor_prohibition.social_consequence: Children gain their schooling; poor families lose a wage they relied on, and some hide their youngest at home piecework.

premium_bonus_pay.name: Premium Bonus Pay
premium_bonus_pay.observation: The rate-fixer sets eight hours for a cylinder head; the turner who finishes in six is paid for half the time he saved.

minimum_wage_boards.name: Minimum Wage Boards
minimum_wage_boards.observation: The chainmakers' board fixes a legal minimum per hundredweight, and women hammering links at backyard forges see their pay nearly double.
minimum_wage_boards.ability_reason: Fixing a floor under the worst-paid trades ends the race to the bottom that sweating made possible.

examined_trade_apprenticeships.name: Examined Apprenticeships
examined_trade_apprenticeships.observation: The apprentice fitter files a dovetail joint to three thousandths of an inch while an examiner watches, then sits a written paper on drawing.

industrial_arbitration_courts.name: Industrial Arbitration Courts
industrial_arbitration_courts.observation: A judge in a plain courtroom hears the shearers and the pastoralists for three weeks, then hands down a wage award binding on both.

work_rest_limits.observation: Investigators time the shell-turners hour by hour and find the twelfth hour yields more spoiled work than the first, so shifts are cut and breaks fixed.

scheduled_occupational_diseases.name: Scheduled Industrial Diseases
scheduled_occupational_diseases.observation: A printed schedule now lists lead palsy, phossy jaw, anthrax and miners' eye; a worker who shows the signs is paid as if he had been injured.

general_strike.name: General Strike
general_strike.observation: No tram runs, no bread is baked and no gas lamps are lit; the city's streets fill with idle crowds and mounted police.
general_strike.social_consequence: Workers show how much the city depends on them; shopkeepers and the poorest families go hungry while it lasts.

public_labor_exchanges.name: Public Labor Exchanges
public_labor_exchanges.observation: Men who once walked from gate to gate queue at a counter where a clerk reads out vacancies chalked on a board from firms across the district.

work_motion_studies.name: Time and Motion Study
work_motion_studies.observation: A man with a stopwatch and clipboard times every stoop and lift of the shovel gang, then issues one standard shovel and one standard time for each load.
work_motion_studies.ability_reason: Breaking work into timed motions lets managers set standard tasks and pay, shifting knowledge of the job from worker to office.
work_motion_studies.social_consequence: Output per man climbs sharply; skilled men resent the stopwatch that strips their judgement and speeds them up.

labor_ministry.name: Ministry of Labor
labor_ministry.observation: The new minister for labor, once a boilermaker, takes his chair at the council table with a staff of inspectors, statisticians and conciliators.
labor_ministry.ability_reason: Labor becomes a permanent charge of government, with one office answerable for wages, safety, disputes and the jobless.

moving_assembly_line.name: Moving Assembly Line
moving_assembly_line.observation: A rope winch drags each motor chassis slowly past the men; each tightens the same few nuts all day, and a car rolls off every few minutes.
moving_assembly_line.ability_reason: Bringing the work to fixed stations cuts assembly time many times over and makes complex machines cheap enough for ordinary households.
moving_assembly_line.social_consequence: Wage earners can buy what they build; the men on the line endure numbing repetition, and turnover soars.

domestic_service_decline.name: Domestic Service Decline
domestic_service_decline.observation: Girls who would have gone into service as maids now take jobs in the telephone exchange and the shop; advertisements for a cook go unanswered.

high_day_wage.name: High Day Wage
high_day_wage.observation: A crowd of ten thousand men stands in the snow outside the motor works the morning after it announces double the going day wage.

industrial_welfare_departments.name: Industrial Welfare Departments
industrial_welfare_departments.observation: The works now has a canteen serving hot dinners, a nurse in a white apron in the first-aid room, and a sports club sponsored by the firm.

employment_departments.name: Employment Departments
employment_departments.observation: Foremen no longer hire at the gate; a department with card files records each worker's trade, wage, lateness and training.

eight_hour_day_law.name: Eight-Hour Day Law
eight_hour_day_law.observation: The factory whistle now blows at four in the afternoon; the long day that ran from dawn to dark is gone by law across every trade.
eight_hour_day_law.ability_reason: A legal eight-hour day, forty-eight hours a week, sets the rhythm of modern working life and frees evenings for family, learning and rest.
eight_hour_day_law.social_consequence: Workers gain leisure and health; employers must hire more hands or run shifts to keep the same output.

standing_labor_conference.name: Standing Labor Conference
standing_labor_conference.observation: Delegates of governments, employers and unions from many realms sit together each year and vote conventions on hours, night work and child labor.

works_councils.name: Works Councils
works_councils.observation: The employees of the chemical works elect a council of nine who meet management each month about dismissals, hours and the canteen.

five_day_week.name: Five-Day Week
five_day_week.observation: The motor works closes on Saturdays as well as Sundays; workers spend the weekend on day trips, and the shopkeepers find them spending more.

work_group_morale_studies.name: Work Group Morale Studies
work_group_morale_studies.observation: Researchers watching a small room of relay assemblers find output rising whatever the lighting, because the women feel noticed and work as a team.

slump_hunger_marches.name: Hunger Marches
slump_hunger_marches.observation: Unemployed shipyard men walk three hundred miles to the capital in worn boots, sleeping in workhouses, to hand the council a petition.

public_relief_works.name: Public Relief Works
public_relief_works.observation: Thousands of jobless men swing picks on a new highway and pour concrete for a river dam, each paid a relief wage by the week.

industrial_unions.name: Industrial Unions
industrial_unions.observation: Machinists, sweepers and assemblers at the steel works all carry the same card; one union now bargains for every man in the mill.

collective_bargaining_law.name: Collective Bargaining Law
collective_bargaining_law.observation: Workers vote by secret ballot under a board's supervision, and the company is bound by law to sit down with the union that wins.
collective_bargaining_law.ability_reason: A legal duty to bargain, enforced by a board, makes unions a settled part of industry instead of something to be broken.
collective_bargaining_law.social_consequence: Union membership swells in mass-production plants; employers lose the right to fire organisers and must negotiate every contract.

sit_down_strikes.name: Sit-Down Strikes
sit_down_strikes.observation: The body-shop workers simply stop and sit on the car seats, refusing to leave; wives pass food up through the windows for six weeks.

paid_annual_holidays.name: Paid Annual Holidays
paid_annual_holidays.observation: For the first time, mill families take a week at the seaside with pay; the holiday trains leave town packed with buckets and cases.

penal_labor_camps.name: Penal Labor Camps
penal_labor_camps.observation: Columns of prisoners in padded jackets march under guard to dig a canal through frozen ground; many do not come back.
penal_labor_camps.social_consequence: The state gets canals and mines built without wages; prisoners pay with their health and lives, and terror silences everyone else.

national_minimum_wage.name: National Minimum Wage
national_minimum_wage.observation: Posters in every workplace announce a legal floor of pay per hour and a forty-hour week, with overtime at time and a half beyond it.
national_minimum_wage.ability_reason: A single national floor under wages and hours reaches every trade, not just the sweated ones, and props up spending through the slump.
national_minimum_wage.social_consequence: The lowest-paid gain most; small employers in poor districts complain they cannot pay it, and some hire fewer hands.

total_labor_mobilization.name: Total Labor Mobilization
total_labor_mobilization.observation: Women in headscarves rivet aircraft wings and turn shell cases on the night shift, while directed workers are sent wherever the ministry needs them.
total_labor_mobilization.social_consequence: Women prove themselves in heavy industry and many will not go back; everyone works longer shifts under direction and rationing.

wartime_wage_controls.name: Wartime Wage Controls
wartime_wage_controls.observation: A war labor board freezes pay scales across industry; union leaders sign a pledge of no strikes until the peace, though wildcat walkouts still flare.

tripartite_wage_bargaining.name: Tripartite Wage Bargaining
tripartite_wage_bargaining.observation: Each spring the union federation, the employers' confederation and the finance minister agree one pay rise for the whole economy.

board_level_codetermination.name: Board-Level Codetermination
board_level_codetermination.observation: A steelworker in his best suit takes his seat among the bankers on the company's supervisory board and votes on the new rolling mill.

negotiated_occupational_pensions.name: Negotiated Occupational Pensions
negotiated_occupational_pensions.observation: The contract now sets aside cents from every hour worked into a pension fund; retired machinists draw a monthly cheque beside the state pension.

public_sector_unions.name: Public Sector Unions
public_sector_unions.observation: Teachers, sanitation men and postal clerks win the right to bargain; the first municipal strike leaves rubbish piled on every corner.

quality_circles.name: Quality Circles
quality_circles.observation: Once a week eight line workers gather round a flip chart in the canteen, tallying defects by cause and proposing their own fixes.

automation_retraining.name: Automation Retraining
automation_retraining.observation: Men whose jobs went to the new automatic transfer machines sit in a classroom learning to read wiring diagrams and repair control cabinets.

equal_pay_law.name: Equal Pay Law
equal_pay_law.observation: Women sewing car seat covers win a strike for the same grading as the men, and the law soon forbids paying a woman less for the same work.
equal_pay_law.ability_reason: Paying women the same rate for the same work opens whole trades to them and draws half the population fully into the paid workforce.
equal_pay_law.social_consequence: Women's pay rises toward men's; employers resist by regrading jobs, and the gap narrows only slowly.

flexible_working_hours.name: Flexible Working Hours
flexible_working_hours.observation: Clerks swipe a card at any time between seven and ten, so long as they are at their desks from ten to three and make up their hours by the month.

lean_production.name: Lean Production
lean_production.observation: Parts arrive in small bins as a card is sent back for more, and any worker who spots a fault pulls a cord that stops the whole line.
lean_production.ability_reason: Building only to demand and letting any worker stop the line for a defect slashes waste and inventory and raises quality far above mass production.
lean_production.social_consequence: Firms that adopt it overwhelm rivals; workers gain a voice on quality but work at a tighter, stressed pace with no buffer.

occupational_safety_agency.name: Occupational Safety Agency
occupational_safety_agency.observation: An inspector with a noise meter and dust sampler writes up the foundry for exceeding the exposure limit, and the fine comes with a deadline.
occupational_safety_agency.ability_reason: A national agency setting exposure limits and enforcing them with fines drives workplace deaths down steadily for decades.

age_discrimination_ban.name: Age Discrimination Ban
age_discrimination_ban.observation: Job advertisements may no longer ask for men under thirty-five; a fifty-year-old draughtsman laid off sues and wins his post back.

redundancy_pay.name: Redundancy Pay
redundancy_pay.observation: The shipyard closes with ninety days' notice; each riveter leaves with a lump sum of a week's pay for every year he served.
redundancy_pay.social_consequence: Laid-off workers get a cushion; the old industrial towns still lose their trade, and the young move away.

service_economy_shift.name: Service Economy Shift
service_economy_shift.observation: The old mill is now a shopping centre, and the grandchildren of weavers work tills, hospital wards, offices and hotel kitchens.

temporary_agency_work.name: Temporary Agency Work
temporary_agency_work.observation: Half the packers in the warehouse wear agency tabards, hired week by week at lower rates than the permanent staff beside them.

labor_market_deregulation.name: Labor Market Deregulation
labor_market_deregulation.observation: Closed-shop agreements are voided and strike ballots made compulsory; union offices that once filled a street now share a single floor.
labor_market_deregulation.social_consequence: Employers gain flexibility and investment returns; bargaining power drains from workers, and wage gaps widen year after year.

desktop_office_work.name: Desktop Office Work
desktop_office_work.observation: The typing pool is gone; every clerk has a humming desk computer with a green-lit screen, and the ledgers become spreadsheets.

workplace_harassment_rules.name: Workplace Harassment Rules
workplace_harassment_rules.observation: A secretary who was groped by her manager files a complaint, and the tribunal awards damages; the firm sends every supervisor to training.

offshored_work.name: Offshored Work
offshored_work.observation: The shoe factory's machines are crated and shipped abroad; the shoes return in containers stamped with a distant port's mark, cheaper than ever.
offshored_work.social_consequence: Consumers get cheap goods and distant workers get factory jobs; the home factory towns are gutted and turn against the trade.

disability_accommodation.name: Disability Accommodation
disability_accommodation.observation: The office installs a ramp, a lowered desk and screen-reading software, and a wheelchair-using accountant joins the audit team.

call_centre_work.name: Call-Centre Work
call_centre_work.observation: Rows of headset-wearing agents take call after call as a wall board shows the queue; each second of wrap time is logged against their name.

common_working_time_rules.name: Common Working-Time Rules
common_working_time_rules.observation: Junior doctors across the allied realms can no longer be rostered past forty-eight hours a week, with eleven hours of rest between shifts.

networked_telework.name: Networked Telework
networked_telework.observation: Half the insurance staff log in from their kitchen tables; the office tower's lifts run near empty and the commuter trains thin out.

zero_hours_contracts.name: Zero-Hours Contracts
zero_hours_contracts.observation: A care worker checks her phone each night to learn whether she has shifts tomorrow; some weeks she has forty hours, some weeks none.

living_wage_indexing.name: Indexed Living Wage
living_wage_indexing.observation: The wage floor now rises automatically each year to a set share of median pay, and supermarket cleaners see their hourly rate climb sharply.

platform_gig_work.name: Platform Gig Work
platform_gig_work.observation: Riders with square insulated bags weave through traffic, their phones pinging a new delivery the instant the last one is handed over.
platform_gig_work.ability_reason: Software that matches tasks to workers in seconds turns whole trades into on-demand piecework, outside the employment law built over two centuries.
platform_gig_work.social_consequence: Customers and platforms gain instant service; riders and drivers carry their own costs and risks with no sick pay or pension.

algorithmic_management.name: Algorithmic Management
algorithmic_management.observation: A warehouse picker's handheld scanner counts down the seconds to the next shelf, and a low rate triggers an automatic warning, then dismissal.

right_to_disconnect.name: Right to Disconnect
right_to_disconnect.observation: Company mail servers now hold messages sent after seven in the evening until the morning, and managers may not demand replies on weekends.

platform_worker_status.name: Platform Worker Status
platform_worker_status.observation: The court rules the drivers are workers, not independent contractors; they gain holiday pay, a minimum wage and a pension pot that follows them.

worker_monitoring_limits.name: Worker Monitoring Limits
worker_monitoring_limits.observation: Employers must now disclose every keystroke logger and camera, and may not track workers' phones off the clock.

four_day_week_trials.name: Four-Day Week Trials
four_day_week_trials.observation: Seventy firms close every Friday for six months at full pay; most find output holds, and sick days and resignations fall.

paid_care_work.name: Paid Care Work
paid_care_work.observation: A daughter caring for her father at home now draws carers' leave from her job and earns pension credits for the years she spends nursing him.

heat_stress_work_limits.name: Heat Stress Limits
heat_stress_work_limits.observation: When the thermometer on the site passes forty degrees, the foreman sounds the horn and the scaffolders come down to shade and water until evening.

machine_assistant_desk_work.name: Machine Assistant Desk Work
machine_assistant_desk_work.observation: The junior analyst types a request in plain words; in seconds the assistant drafts the contract, summarizes the report and writes the code.
machine_assistant_desk_work.ability_reason: Machines that draft, summarize and reason reach into clerical and professional work that earlier automation never touched.
machine_assistant_desk_work.social_consequence: Experienced workers become far more productive; entry-level desk jobs vanish, and the ladder into the professions loses its lowest rungs.

lifelong_learning_accounts.name: Lifelong Learning Accounts
lifelong_learning_accounts.observation: A forty-five-year-old bus driver spends the credit in her learning account on an evening course in network maintenance.

basic_income_pilots.name: Basic Income Pilots
basic_income_pilots.observation: Two thousand households receive a monthly sum with no conditions; researchers find most keep working, while some return to study or care.
